input: How can I make an automated logging of meals so that when I eat something every breakfast, it is just there instead of me having to log it each day.

reports.text: Yes—Mizyun has **Recurring meals** for automatic daily or selected-weekday meal logging. In **Meals**, choose **Repeat** on a saved meal, select **Every day** or weekdays, set **Morning · 08:00**, **Evening · 19:00** or a custom time, check the displayed time zone, then tap **Save schedule**. The server adds the saved foods and portions at the scheduled time even while the app is closed. Today's entry is added only if its time is still ahead; missed past days are not backfilled. Open **Meals → Recurring meals** to edit days/time, pause/resume, **Skip today** or stop. To change future foods/portions, stop the schedule, edit a logged meal and choose Repeat again. Automatic entries do not prove what you ate—review, edit or skip them when your day changes. Coach can explain setup; it cannot create or change a schedule for you.
